verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules are a fair axis for an AI assistant, but the evidence never documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions automatically on events. The closest items are a vague claim that Copilot "can automate repetitive tasks" (copilot-docs-17), on-demand multi-step Cowork tasks (copilot-docs-10), and proactive research suggestions (copilot-docs-33). None of these is an event-trigger rule system, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
